errors.text_span: етикетирана като "Източници на отопление по тип населено място"
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the y-axis label. "Източници на отопление по тип населено място" is the title of the chart, not the label for the y-axis, which is unlabeled and shows percentage values.
The description states that the bars are grouped, but the chart is a 100% stacked bar chart.
The color for 'отопление от централен източник' (Heating from a central source) is described as orange, but it is light blue in the chart. There is no orange color used in the legend or the bars.
The color for 'електричество' (Electricity) is described as light blue, but it is green in the chart.

errors.text_span: електричеството и дървата са почти равни на 34.1% и 28.6%
errors.evidence: Describing values of 34.1% and 28.6% as 'almost equal' is an over-generalization, as they have a difference of 5.5 percentage points.
In the 'Градове' (Cities) category, the share of 'дърва' (wood) is 22.8%, not 14.9%. The value 14.9% corresponds to 'въглища' (coal).
In the 'Села' (Villages) category, the share of 'електричество' (electricity) is 4.1%, not 22.8%. The value 22.8% corresponds to 'дърва' (wood) in the 'Градове' (Cities) category.

The sentence discusses 'отоплението от централен източник' (heating from a central source), but its share in 'села' (villages) is 0.2%, not 4.1%. The value 4.1% corresponds to 'електричество' (electricity) in villages.

errors.text_span: Използването на въглища е сравнително равномерно разпределено между трите групи
errors.evidence: Claiming that the use of coal is 'relatively evenly distributed' is highly misleading. The values are 19.8% (Total), 14.9% (Cities), and 32.4% (Villages), which shows significant variation.

The sentence discusses 'въглища' (coal), but its share in 'градовете' (cities) is 14.9%, not 22.7%. The value 22.7% corresponds to 'отопление от централен източник' (heating from a central source) in cities.
